The "average rate of change" over a given time period is mathematically defined as the total change in the value divided by the total change in time, which is exactly `(final_value - initial_value) / (final_time - initial_time)`. 

Confidence Level: 100%

```python
def avg_rate(series):
    dt = series[-1][0] - series[0][0]
    dv = series[-1][1] - series[0][1]
    rate = dv / dt
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
```
